# Websites America

> Websites America builds complete digital foundations for U.S. businesses, with a focus on healthcare practices: website, domain and hosting, Google Business Profile, SEO foundation, analytics, and call tracking, then monthly SEO growth. Tier 1 Foundation is $10,000 one-time plus a $2,000 first-year infrastructure reserve ($12,000 total due). Tier 2 Growth is $2,500/month. Tier 3 Market Authority is $5,000/month. U.S. veterans who own the business get 15% off everything. Rankings are never guaranteed.

- [SEO for Addiction Treatment Centers](https://websitesamerica.com/learn/seo-for-addiction-treatment-centers): How a licensed program can rank against directories and call centers: the pages you need, local SEO, Google spam rules, EKRA and privacy-safe measurement.

- [LegitScript Certification and Your Addiction Treatment Website](https://websitesamerica.com/learn/legitscript-certification-addiction-treatment-websites): What LegitScript reviews on an addiction treatment website before Google and Meta will run your ads: standards, fees, timeline, and a pre-application checklist.
